description: Source code for handling image tags in firmware, including CRC calculations, image validation, and fix-up routines for embedded device firmware images.

methods.name: strntoul
methods.description: Converts a string segment to an unsigned 32-bit integer with specified length and base.

methods.name: compute_crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a specified file region.

methods.name: trx_fixup
methods.description: Fixes or updates the imagetag header CRC and related fields in a firmware image.

methods.name: trx_check
methods.description: Validates the firmware image header CRC and checks if it fits in the specified MTD device.

methods.name: mtd_fixtrx
methods.description: Fixes the TRX header in a specified MTD device at a given offset.
